name: Tethercam
tagline: Your iPhone as a Windows webcam over USB, at up to 4K.
summary: Tethercam turns an iPhone into a standard Windows 11 webcam that Teams, Zoom, OBS, Streamlabs and browsers can use. The phone hardware-encodes H.264, the PC decodes it on the GPU, and a Windows 11 virtual camera hands it to any app. No account, no watermark, no Wi-Fi: plug in the cable and pick the camera.

highlights.title: Full resolution
highlights.text: Every format the phone's lenses offer, up to 3840×2160 at 60 fps, exposed as standard webcam formats.

highlights.title: USB only
highlights.text: Video travels through Apple's USB tunnel; nothing touches the network. ~100 ms glass-to-glass at 1080p30.

highlights.title: A real virtual camera
highlights.text: A Frame Server media source registered with MFCreateVirtualCamera, so it works in every Windows 11 camera app.

highlights.title: Built for streaming
highlights.text: A local status API lets stream overlays hide the camera while the phone is offline.
